description: Upload a local file (icon, splash screen, logo, etc.) from the developer's filesystem to Nativine cloud. Returns the cloud URL and path to use in config.

localFilePath.description: Absolute path to the local file to upload (e.g. /Users/dev/project/public/logo.png)

type.description: Asset type: icon (app icon), splashIcon (splash logo), splashFullImage (full splash), floatingBtnIcon (FAB icon), headerLogo (header logo)

name: nativine_upload_asset
